Class Projects — CMSC 405: Advanced Data Science

Project 2: Movie Database Design & SQL Analysis
Tools: R, SQL, DuckDB, ggplot2
Topics: Relational databases, SQL querying, data visualization
A collaborative project in which we designed and populated a relational movie database using DuckDB, then wrote SQL queries to explore genre ratings, profitability, and movie popularity over time. Includes visualizations of trends from 1980–2016.



Project 3: The Hidden Sentiment of Movie Critic Reviews
Tools: R, tidytext, ggridges, AFINN sentiment lexicon, ggplot2
Topics: Text mining, sentiment analysis, TF-IDF, data visualization
A text-mining deep dive into thousands of Rotten Tomatoes critic reviews. Using AFINN sentiment scoring, we uncovered how critics write differently across genres and how sentiment patterns have shifted across four decades and content ratings.

About Me
Hi, I’m Zoe! I am a student-athlete at Lawrence University graduating in June 2026 with a degree in Computer Science and a minor in Data Science — with departmental honors. I’m originally from Algonquin, Illinois.
I’m passionate about sports analytics and love exploring the intersection of data and real-world decision-making. Whether I’m building a relational database, running a sentiment analysis, or finding patterns in a dataset, I enjoy turning raw data into meaningful stories.
Outside of academics, you’ll find me on the softball field, out on a hiking trail, spending time with family and friends, or drawing.
